usage_policy: MASTER_PROMPT reads this file instead of embedding execution rules. All phases reference this single policy document.

dependency_rules.fallback_behavior: If optional missing, continue with warning and use default rules from DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md or BRAND.md. If required missing, stop pipeline and return clear error identifying missing file.

retry_strategy.failure_handling: If generation fails, log error in execution_state, return partial output with error details, never fabricate missing content.

caching_policy.cache_refresh: Once per execution. Not refreshed between steps.
caching_policy.purpose: Reduce file I/O, improve retrieval speed, ensure consistency.

failure_policy.required_missing: Stop pipeline. Return error identifying missing file. Log in execution_state.
failure_policy.optional_missing: Continue pipeline. Log warning. Use fallback rules from DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md or BRAND.md.
failure_policy.conflicting_data: Stop pipeline. Report conflict (higher authority wins: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md > RULES.md > Knowledge > Template > Output). Log in execution_state.
